verdicts.reason: A: the orange divider line runs straight through 'Blend Yet', so it reads like a strikethrough. The logo has shrunk to an illegible dot and wordmark inside a large empty dark panel, while the text column on the right is jammed top to bottom with no breathing room. B: the logo keeps its proportions, there are no collisions and the layout reads left to right. Its flaws: the eyebrow is pushed under the logo panel with a stray divider above it, the 3-line headline runs almost to the top and bottom edges, the right column of body copy, CTA and legal is cramped, and the legal text is too small to read.
